text:
Ellie Park: Marketplace asked for a concise evidence bundle for the SI+HW listing: redacted SOC2 summary, pen-test executive summary, firmware checksums, signed manifest, and a signed attestation that redactions were performed. They want a single upload window and a 72h reviewer SLA.
Tom Nguyen: Ops can provision a partner prefix and presigned URLs. Suggest 5 day expiry and SSE-KMS enforced. We'll require .sha512 files and a manifest.json.sig GPG signature.
Ibrahim Khan: Security note: full pen-test reports require legal sign-off before sharing. We'll provide an exec summary and a redaction checklist (PII, hostnames, API keys, db dumps). I'll prep the checklist.
Rae Kim: For firmware artifacts, require build-id, build-date, signing fingerprint in the manifest. Partners must upload manifest + .sha512 first, then binaries. We'll run a server-side checksum validation and emit validation-<ts>.txt.
Ellie Park: Action owners: Tom = create prefix + presign workflow + lifecycle (14 days) + logging; Ibrahim = redaction checklist + SOC2 exec summary; Rae = manifest/signing guidance + validation script; I'll coordinate marketplace PM and confirm upload window. @DevOpsBot open a ticket.
DevOpsBot: Created ticket INF-4599: "marketplace - SI_HW evidence intake (si-321)" assigned to Ellie, Tom, Ibrahim, Rae. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-4599 :robot_face:
Tom Nguyen: Suggested upload instructions for partners (in email): "Upload to s3://marketplace-evidence/partners/si-321/ — each artifact requires <artifact>.sha512 and manifest.json.sig. Links expire in 5 days. Use SSE-KMS. Contact infra@redwood.com for help."
Ibrahim Khan: Legal will draft an attestation template. Marketplace prefers signed PDF; if partner cannot sign, accept an emailed attest from a named exec plus Slack confirmation.
Rae Kim: We'll also ask partners to supply GPG public key fingerprint via secure channel before upload. That will speed verification.
Ellie Park: Timeline: Ibrahim posts checklist by Tue EOD, Tom posts presign path by Wed AM, Rae posts manifest template Wed AM, partners upload Thu. Update INF-4599 with blockers. :white_check_mark:
